data.name: Airport Control 27
data.detailed_description:
Airport Control 27 — A Brand-New 3D Air Traffic Control Simulator.

Here, you will take on the role of a dedicated air traffic controller, providing professional ATC services at airports around the world.

High-Quality Airport Scenery

Experience flight-simulator-quality 3D airport scenery, packed with detail and realism.

  • Fully Animated Jet Bridges: Single and dual-bridge configurations with realistic aircraft docking.

  • Complete Airfield Lighting Systems: Approach lights, runway lights, and taxiway lights built to real-world standards.

  • Accurate Airport Markings: Taxiway markings, runway designators, and stand guidance lines faithfully reproduced from real-world airports.

  • More airports are continuously being added.

Realistic Radio Communications

Authentic air-to-ground communication procedures based on real-world aviation standards.

  • ATC instructions and pilot readbacks synchronized with your commands in real time.

  • Multiple pilot accents from around the world, with optional Chinese or English voice communications.

Highly Realistic Operations

Regularly updated procedures based on real-world airport operations.

  • Authentic STARs, APPs, SIDs, altitude restrictions, and speed restrictions.

  • Runway usage restrictions, taxiway pavement limitations, wingspan restrictions, and other taxi route constraints.

Flexible Ground Control

  • Freely choose pushback positions.

  • Create and assign custom taxi routes with a single click.

  • Queue Commands: Follow the aircraft ahead, follow a follow-me vehicle, and give way at intersections.

  • Runway Operations: Line up and wait, takeoff clearance, and runway exit assignment.

  • Special situations fully supported, including holding position and waiting off the taxiway.

  • Tug vehicles can be dispatched from any location.

Built for Hardcore Players

  • 4K & Ultrawide Support

  • Steam Workshop — Share your custom liveries and flight schedules with the world.

Roadmap

data.short_description: Airport Control is a next-generation 3D ATC simulation. Take the positions at airports worldwide—marshalling taxis, sequencing departures, and spacing arrivals. Remember: Safe, orderly, expeditious.
data.supported_languages:
Simplified Chinese*, English*
*languages with full audio support
